en: A hand‑colored vintage postcard showing a gently sloping cobblestone street lined with two‑ to three‑story houses with red tiled roofs. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. German text at the top names the location as Lommatzsch and the street as Korngasse. Additional smaller German text appears at the bottom, including a printer credit and a note that it is a hand‑colored artist card.
